event: 2025 ILCA 4 YOUTH EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIPS & OPEN EUROPEAN TROPHY
procedural_matters: BRA 217608 was represented by Erik Scheidt.
The race committee was represented by Michal Jodlowski (Course Race Officer Area B).
Max Jablecki (race committee member) attended the hearing as an observer.
Before the hearing, BRA 217608 went to the RC and asked to review the video of the start of race 11 (F5).
facts: In race 11 (F5) of the ILCA 4 Boys gold fleet, the black flag was used as the preparatory signal.
Within the last 15 seconds before the starting signal of the race, BRA 217608 was inside the triangle formed by the ends of the line and the first mark, close to the pin end.
BRA 217608 was identified by the race committee on the pin end vessel of the starting line.
The race committee displayed a general recall after the starting signal of the race.
The race committee displayed BRA 217608 sail number on the board before the next warning signal.
BRA 217608 was scored BFD in race 11 (F5).
conclusions: By scoring BRA 217608 who was identified inside the triangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first mark during the last minute before the starting signal as BFD, the race committee did not do an improper action or omission. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
decision: Redress is not given to BRA 217608.
